Three sourced macro-to-company proxies (NOAA heat to GTV, JOLTS to seats, Watsco/AHRI against Lennox) all pointing one way, each filed small because none is a company-level number and all three sit against a +5.14 paid-downside skew and a 13.7% five-day fall.

Guide arithmetic from the company's own releases on a two-analyst name plus a 25%-of-float short with 49 days to cover, netted against the real chance this fiscal-year-end print again refuses to guide and the 27-Dec-2026 covenant snapback; the last two are one FY27 cluster so the second is sized down.

RPO +88% with lengthening duration is a primary-document number no preview cites and it lands on guidance headroom, but it reads through to total revenue rather than the Atlas rate the market trades, and a full field-and-product rebuild sat inside the reported quarter against a +23% twenty-day run-up.

Volume and rate point opposite ways and rate is the one that lands on accommodation commission and on tonight's Q3 guide, which is the line that took this stock down 12.55% the last time it moved; the CAAC print partly offsets and the stock is already at a 52-week low.

The FY27 guide needs a four-point revenue inflection starting in the quarter being reported and the new CFO's first ownable quarter arrives five days after his predecessor's advisory contract lapsed; against that, Docebo's raise and a first contractually-due refinancing update on a $60m stub over $574.6m of debt are a real positive tail.

A 9%-of-float unregistered block came out of lock-up on 23 August with no Form 144 trail and is excluded from every quoted float, into a 68% rally lit by a buyback release that adds no authorisation and whose utilisation the print must disclose for the first time; the production-decline leg is cut because the second hunt shows it was public on 17 August and the tape rose after it.

The covenant arithmetic is the one document-based finding here and it names why the market is wrong about a +6.18 skew (26% revolver usage is below the 35% test threshold), with the 08-31 officer grants keyed to H2 comp growth as a second confidence tell; the World Cup leg is filed negative because the lift was concentrated in host metros and this is a 230-store national footprint, and the weather leg is kept deliberately tiny.

A whole third shift being staffed down to janitor and security at Torrington is the right kind of unaggregated tell, but it is about the ramp rather than this quarter's lines, and ten weeks of silence on the Fit CEPA with its only alignment warrants 58% out of the money cuts the other way into the strongest paid-downside skew in the pack (+11.64).
